fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/doclinks/... passes (no broken relative link in the real README.md and docs/) and make self-check passes (rhiza check's docs-commands rule finds no rhiza command in README.md or docs/ that does not exist), grep finds 'rhiza apply' in the agent loop's write-back step of docs/agents.md, and the owner approves docs/agents.md at the run's sign-off
fields.statement: docs/agents.md reads in the owner's voice; its agent loop keeps writing back with one rhiza apply <file> --json, the batch and agent path that constraint doc-examples-plain-commands and the rhiza skill prescribe, and only an example of a person writing the model by hand uses plain rhiza add, link or set commands
